# BAD-066 — Nothing enforces import 'server-only' on admin server modules

## Brief
Spike section 5 claims 'same guard' and section 10 says to keep server-only on every leaf including the type-only ones, but no test, lint rule or build step checks it. The guard is what makes a client component's value import of a server module fail loudly; after the split thirteen files carry it where one did, so the chance of a future edit dropping it silently is thirteen times higher. A lint rule or one text test over admin/src/lib/**.ts would cost a single assertion.

Evidence: Deleted line 1 of admin/src/lib/accounts/detail-types.ts on the BAD-052 working tree and re-ran the whole recipe: admin npm run verify exit 0 (typecheck, eslint 0 errors, build compiled, check:standalone PASS, check:secrets PASS); the five text-assertion tests 28 pass 0 fail 0 skipped; the section 8 step 3 export diff empty; verify-moves 'OK: 58 statements, every one moved exactly once' exit 0. Four checks, none noticed. grep -rn server-only over test/, admin/scripts/ and admin/eslint.config.mjs returns nothing. Distinct from proposal 86, which restricts who may import the leaves rather than guarding the leaves themselves.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus. The work is a text-assertion test in the existing test/server/admin-client-boundary.test.mjs family, which already walks admin/src, parses imports and resolves specs with no build and no database, and which the root npm test (ci.yml) runs as a required check — cheaper and better enforced than a custom eslint rule that only admin-ci's verify would see. The judgment the ticket needs is the rule's shape, not its wiring: a blanket 'every .ts under lib/' is wrong, because action-state.ts, cookies.ts, env.ts, format.ts and platforms.ts are deliberately client-safe and the five 'use server' leaves under lib/actions/ are meant to be importable from the client. Opus rather than fable because a rule that is too lax merely restores today's silence, and the brief pins the proof that catches that: the deletion in the ticket's evidence must turn the suite red.
